EmailTemplate.name: Overdue Invoice Reminder
EmailTemplate.subject: Reminder: Overdue Invoice - {{InvoiceName}}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
This is a friendly reminder regarding your overdue invoice(s).
Invoice Number Due Date Amount Due Days Overdue
Please make the payment at your earliest convenience to avoid further delays.
If you have already made the payment ignore this email.
Thank you for your prompt attention.
Best regards,
